legislation.notes: Introduced 5 January 2026 by Senator Wiener. Passed the Senate 35-1. In the Assembly it was amended 15 June 2026 and re-referred to Appropriations; the last recorded action is 29 June 2026, "July 1 hearing postponed by committee". Not law. Caps a portable solar generation device at 1,200 W aggregated AC output per dwelling and exempts it from interconnection requirements, while allowing a utility to require simple online registration.
